Meta.title: AfriConnecta — Connecting Minds. Advancing Africa.
Meta.description: AfriConnecta connects institutions with academic experts from Africa and the diaspora for teaching, research and collaboration.

Landing.headline: Find African Expertise. Build Knowledge. Transform Futures.
Landing.subheadline: AfriConnecta connects institutions with academic experts from Africa and the diaspora for teaching, research and collaboration.

Search.title: Find an expert
Search.subtitle: Search by topic, institution or name. Narrow the results with the filters.
Search.empty: No experts match this search yet. Try fewer filters or a broader topic.
Search.emptyTail: There are no more results on this page.
Search.broadenedNotice: No exact matches, so this is a broadened search across the wider field.
Search.similarNotice: No exact matches for “{term}”. These names and institutions are spelled similarly.

Opportunities.title: Opportunity Board
Opportunities.subtitle: Guest lectures, research collaborations, supervision and consulting posted by institutions.
Opportunities.newSubtitle: Drafts stay private to your institution until you publish.
Opportunities.expertIdHint: Use the expert’s profile id from their public URL or from search (demo: Yves Habimana is bbbbbbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb).

OpportunityErrors.coverLetterTooLong: Keep the cover letter under 5000 characters.
OpportunityErrors.expertRequired: Enter a valid expert profile id.
OpportunityErrors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
OpportunityErrors.unknown: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

Login.title: Sign in
Login.subtitle: Use the email and password you registered with.

Profile.title: Your expert profile
Profile.subtitle: This is what institutions will see when the profile is published.
Profile.photoHint: JPEG or PNG, up to {limit} MB. Location and camera data are removed before storing.
Profile.cvHint: PDF, up to {limit} MB. Only institutions that have unlocked your contacts can open it.

fileErrors.unsupportedFormat: Only JPEG, PNG and PDF files are accepted.
fileErrors.formatMismatch: That format does not fit this field: a photo must be JPEG or PNG, a CV must be a PDF.
fileErrors.malformed: That file could not be read. Try exporting it again.
fileErrors.storage: The file could not be saved. Please try again.

Profile.publishedHint: Unpublished profiles stay a draft. Only you can see them.
Profile.expertiseHint: Choose the areas you work in. At least one is required to publish.
Profile.languagesHint: At least one language is required to publish. Proficiency follows the CEFR scale.

Register.chooseSubtitle: AfriConnecta has two sides. Pick the one that describes you.
Register.expertCardBody: Researchers, lecturers and professors from Africa and the diaspora who want to be found for teaching, research and collaboration.
Register.institutionCardBody: Universities, research institutes, government bodies and organisations looking for academic expertise.
Register.expertSubtitle: You can complete your profile, photo and CV after confirming your email.
Register.institutionSubtitle: Your institution is reviewed before it can contact experts.
Register.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Length beats symbols.
Register.biographyHint: Optional. You can write this later.
Register.institutionHint: Where you work right now. Free text is fine.
Register.checkEmailBody: If the address you entered is not already registered, a confirmation link is on its way. The link is valid for one hour.
Register.checkEmailHint: Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder before trying again.
Register.failedBody: Confirmation links expire after an hour and can only be used once.
Register.welcomeBody: Email confirmed. Here is what we recorded for you.

RegisterErrors.websiteInvalid: Enter a full address, including https://
RegisterErrors.weakPassword: That password was rejected. Try a longer one.
RegisterErrors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
RegisterErrors.unknown: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
RegisterErrors.unconfirmed: Confirm your email before signing in. Check your inbox for the link.
RegisterErrors.visibilityInvalid: Select who can see this profile.
RegisterErrors.expertiseRequired: Choose at least one area of expertise to publish.
RegisterErrors.languageRequired: Add at least one language to publish.
RegisterErrors.languageInvalid: Choose a language and a proficiency level.
RegisterErrors.languageDuplicate: Each language can be added only once.
